description:
The arm64 Steam bootstrapper runs and installs the full client, but the client aborts at load on a missing symbol.

**Tested with:** darlinghq/darling commit `362b6a1f400ce0be97a14f1a85b422f851a22d66`, built natively on aarch64 Linux, rootless mode via the staged launcher.

**How to get the arm64 build:** the macOS installer on steampowered.com ships an x86_64-only bootstrapper, which can't run on arm64. Valve's update manifest (`client-update.steamstatic.com/steam_client_osx`, entry `appdmg_osx`) serves a universal bootstrapper with an arm64 half (SHA-256 checked against the manifest). Writing `publicbeta` to `~/Library/Application Support/Steam/package/beta` in the prefix makes it install the native arm64 client.

**Result:**

- Bootstrapper: runs, downloads about 289 MB of packages, extracts them, logs `Update complete, launching Steam...`
- Downloaded client (universal, arm64 half): aborts at load (exit 134):

      dyld: Symbol not found: _LSCopyKindStringForRef
      Expected in: /System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Versions/A/CoreServices

All other non-weak system libraries it links directly exist. Nothing is known about what comes after this symbol.

Also seen: `-[MacWorkspace setIcon:forFile:options:] unimplemented` (Cocotron AppKit) and a failed check `m_NamedPipe >= 0` in `steamglobalinstance.cpp`, not yet investigated.

Details: darlinghq/darling#2220. Related: #2195 (Steam games need a Steam client; Geometry Dash stops at `SteamAPI_Init`).
